## Guides

- How Much Does Auto Transport Cost: U.S. shipments typically run $600 to $2,000. Per-mile rates fall as distance rises. Enclosed transport costs about 30 to 60% more than open.
- Open vs Enclosed Auto Transport: open is the affordable industry standard; enclosed adds protection for luxury, classic, and high-value vehicles.
- Broker vs Carrier Explained: a carrier owns the trucks; a broker coordinates shipments across a network of vetted carriers.
